title: Amazon Adjusts AI Strategy: Halts Most Nova In-House Model Research, Resources Shift to Pete Abel Team
excerpt: According to Insider, citing insiders, Amazon is making significant adjustments to its AI strategy, halting the active development of most of its in-house Nova
content_html:
According to Insider, citing insiders, Amazon is making significant adjustments to its AI strategy, halting the active development of most of its in-house Nova series large models. This reduction covers the flagship Nova Premier and Omni models, the Reel video model, and the Canvas image generator; these models have been moved into "maintenance mode," serving only existing customers. Previously, Amazon had already laid off staff in its AGI department and shut down the AGI lab established after acquiring Adept in 2024.

Although it has scaled back its first in-house product lines, Amazon has not exited the competition for top-tier AI. Currently, R&D resources are fully redirected to the cutting-edge model research team led by Peter Abeles (who joined through the acquisition of robot startup Covariant). A new foundational model is expected to be officially announced at this year's re:Invent conference. An Amazon spokesperson emphasized that AI models remain one of the company's most core projects. At the same time, as one of the largest supporters of Anthropic and OpenAI, its related investments may have exceeded $10 billion.

This adjustment indicates that tech giants are shifting from "spreading out across multiple fronts" to "concentrating resources on a single top-tier cutting-edge model." While strengthening its cloud ecosystem and external investments, Amazon is striving to reshape its competitive position in the forefront of large models through precise technological breakthroughs.

content_html_zh:
据 Insider 援引内部人士消息称，亚马逊正在对其 AI 战略进行重大调整，停止了大部分自研 Nova 系列大型机型的积极开发。 此次缩减涵盖了旗舰产品 Nova Premier 和 Omni 型号、Reel 视频型号以及 Canvas 图像生成器；这些型号已转入“维护模式”，仅为现有客户提供服务。 此前，亚马逊已经裁员了AGI部门的员工，并关闭了2024年收购Adept后建立的AGI实验室。

尽管亚马逊已经缩减了首批内部产品线，但它并没有退出顶级人工智能的竞争。 目前，研发资源全面转向​​由Peter Abeles（通过收购机器人初创公司Covariant加入）领导的前沿模型研究团队。 预计新的基础模型将在今年的 re:Invent 大会上正式公布。 亚马逊发言人强调，人工智能模型仍然是该公司最核心的项目之一。 同时，作为Anthropic和OpenAI的最大支持者之一，其相关投资可能已超过100亿美元。

这一调整表明科技巨头正从“多线布局”转向“集中​​资源打造单一顶级前沿模式”。 在加强云生态和外部投资的同时，亚马逊正努力通过精准的技术突破，重塑其在大机型前沿的竞争地位。
